comparison: Rejected peel is a cramped sliver and wink is heavy. Enlarge the folded quadrant and use a shallow wink. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Enlarged the peel into the lower-right quadrant, opened the fold and softened the wink and smile.

comparison: Rejected cap has an angular projecting hook and omits both hair wings. Restore recognizable draping fabric, pompom and hair silhouette. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restored two open hair curls and a sloping cap tail ending in a pompom; reduced jaw to make space.

comparison: Rejected face and pointed tiara are undersized inside a generic hair arch. Enlarge face, restore distinct crown and long hair above shoulders. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Enlarged circular face and distinct pointed tiara with downward forehead chevron; rebalanced long hair and shoulders.

comparison: Rejected lens has square corners and a sharp nose notch. Restore rounded wraparound lens and smooth nose bridge. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Rounded lens corners and replaced angular nose notch with mirrored smooth lobes; expanded rim height.

comparison: Rejected emblem makes four equivalent triangular sectors. Restore small top, broad bottom and taller side panels around curved X-shaped opening. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restored larger bottom panel, smaller top panel and swept mirrored side panels around the diagonal X opening.

comparison: Rejected dollop was flattened and nozzle reduced to a line. Restore a fuller rounded icing mound and an outlined taper. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restore a fuller rounded icing mound and an outlined taper.

comparison: Rejected sprayer has a single floating dash and squat reservoir. Restore a diverging spray pair, clearer feed tube and more natural gun grip. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restore a diverging spray pair, clearer feed tube and more natural gun grip.

comparison: Rejected oval fruit has three bare crown rays. Restore the pointed calyx as part of the fruit silhouette and an asymmetric branching inner stem. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restore the pointed calyx as part of the fruit silhouette and an asymmetric branching inner stem.

comparison: Rejected fruit is a squat bowl beneath a tall stalk. Restore a full pear-like citrus body and a short stalk with a single pointed leaf. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restored a pointed diagonal leaf, slanted stalk and asymmetric rounded citrus body, with clear leaf-to-fruit spacing.

comparison: Rejected loaf looks like a tall square bread slice. Restore a broad rounded loaf and curved oblique score marks; retain two scores for clearance. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restore a broad rounded loaf and curved oblique score marks; retain two scores for clearance.

comparison: Rejected scissor handles are tiny and film appears as two brackets. Enlarge handles, keep crossing blades, and close the separated film frames to make the cut readable. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Enlarged scissor loops and restored a film strip with two clear frames, a right rail and a cut approached by crossing blades.

comparison: Rejected cow has a dog-like angular muzzle and blocky feet. Restore rounded hanging muzzle, sloped hock and a small ear while preserving the long back. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Rounded the hanging muzzle and balanced the ear, long back and broad legs; omitted small anatomy that crowds the silhouette.

comparison: Rejected case has sharp corners and merges into its conveyor. Round suitcase and handle, separate belt below, and preserve two straps. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Round suitcase and handle, separate belt below, and preserve two straps.

comparison: Rejected bucket looks like a mug with a rigid side loop. Restore broad tapered pail and a swinging handle attached to a visible pivot. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restore broad tapered pail and a swinging handle attached to a visible pivot.

comparison: Rejected boot has square cuff and oversized stepped heel. Round the cuff and toe, add a natural curved ankle and a smaller integrated heel. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Round the cuff and toe, add a natural curved ankle and a smaller integrated heel.

comparison: Rejected pendant is squat and its tiny loop floats separately. Enlarge the loop and join it to a taller pointed pendant. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Enlarge the loop and join it to a taller pointed pendant.

comparison: Rejected hand has a stubby index finger and a single short halo. Lengthen the upright finger and carry the outer contact arc farther around it; keep the open wrist. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restored two concentric contact arcs above an upright index finger and a smooth thumb, keeping the wrist open.

comparison: Rejected leaf pair is symmetric and pearls are solid dots below it. Restore asymmetric leaves on a diagonal stem and three large outlined pearls beside them. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restored asymmetric leaves with diagonal stem and three large outlined pearl circles; reduced five pearls to three for clear interiors.

comparison: Rejected pinafore has wide sloping shoulders and an hourglass bodice. Restore upright shoulder straps, squared neckline and a straight-sided bodice above the flared skirt. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restore upright shoulder straps, squared neckline and a straight-sided bodice above the flared skirt.

comparison: Rejected spoon is a long angular trough and cubes are oversized. Restore a rounded deep bowl at left with a narrow handle, under a compact three-cube stack. No written reviewer feedback.
change: Restore a rounded deep bowl at left with a narrow handle, under a compact three-cube stack.
